blurb: Bounce Empire is an indoor amusement park featuring over 50 inflatable attractions including slides, obstacle courses, and arcade games. The venue includes a full-service restaurant, VIP adult lounge, and a 360° hydraulic concert stage. It offers experiences for families, corporate events, kids' birthday parties, and special events like the 21+ Halloween party Coloween.
extraNote: No outside food or drink allowed except birthday cake for parties · No backpacks or coolers allowed; diaper bags permitted with inspection · Facility is fully air-conditioned with high ceilings and ventilation · Service animals allowed with complimentary booties · No penalty for late arrival; capacity limits may apply · Post-event cleaning fee for excessive mess in party rooms; routine cleaning included · Front Entrance at Bounce Empire, 1380 South Public Road Lafayette, CO 80026
